name: a short request types into a floating prompt bar on a device screen
looks: On a laptop's desktop, a rounded prompt bar fades in mid-screen. A short request types into it character by character with a blinking cursor, small attachment icons sitting quietly to its left and a round submit button waiting on the right.
build: prompt-bar-generate: the prompt bar is a DOM pill with a soft ambient glow behind it, revealed with a scale/opacity pop; the request text types on per character at a steady rate with a blinking block cursor advancing with it; the submit button sits idle, ready for its press-and-release on the next beat.
sound: A soft key tick per character, with a quiet ambient hum under the desktop scene.
prompt: On a clean desktop background, fade in a single rounded prompt bar and type a short, plain request into it character by character with a blinking cursor, small utility icons resting to one side and a round submit button waiting on the other, so the moment reads as asking a tool for exactly one thing.
